FARES - GENERAL INFORMATION
CHILDREN'S FARES-A child in arms under two years of age will be carried free when
accompanied by parent or guardian and provided parent or guardian has paid effective fare.
Children under 12 years of age one-halt fare
BAGGAGE-Sixty-six 66) pounds baggage will be carried free on each ticket between Alaska
points and points outside Alaska. Fifty-five (55) pounds of baggage will be carried free on each
ticket within Alaska. Baggage over the allowable limit will be charged for at the rate per pound
of one-half of one percent on the one-way fare with a minimum charge of twenty-five cents.
Alaska Airlines liability for any personal property, including baggage whether or not checked
or otherwise delivered into the custody of Carrier, is limited to $100 for each passenger unless
a hipher valuation is declared and the additional charges required therefor paid before the
transportation by air commences.
FREIGHT RATES-SPECIAL QUANTITY AND DEFERRED RATES available from Port-
land and Seattle to Fairbanks and Anchorare. For further freicht information including intra-
Alaska freight rates and service please contact your nearest Alaska Airlines Freight Office.
AIR EXPRESS-Contact your Air Express Division, Railway Express Agent or nearest Alaska
Airlines office for information and rates to alaska
SELL AND REPORT: All authorized agents and scheduled airlines may immediately confirm
reservations for travel between Portland-Seattle and Fairbanks, for parties of 3 or less on
Alaska Airlines flights up to 24 hours prior to departure, by reporting sales to the nearest office
of the connecting carrier or to the nearest Alaska Airlines office.

CONVENIENT
Connections AT SEATTLE
TO AND FROM ALASKA
Alaska Airlines' Golden Nugget schedule permits same-day all-jet travel to the
Last Frontier. Northbound passengers from California, the Midwest
and the East Coast can fly to Seattle, transfer to the Golden Nugget Jet
and be in Alaska by 6:50 p.m. "Going out," as Alaskans say, the Golden
Nugget Jet provides the same quick and convenient
connections with jet flights South and East.
